TestControlPlane._comment: JEB-1502: fail-closed to 404 by default. Enable ONLY via TestControlPlane__Enabled=true env var in a non-production test harness environment, never committed true. SharedSecret must be set via env var (TestControlPlane__SharedSecret) — never committed.

DurableRequests._comment: SPINE-FOUNDATION / ADR-006. Default false = today's green in-memory create path (S05 H3 -> 201, S01-S04 unchanged). Flip to true ONLY after state-service saga_bundles + delivery POST /api/v1/deliveries are deployed and smoke-passed, staging-first, via FeatureFlags__DurableRequests__Enabled=true.

RequestExpiry._comment: Rollout switch for WHO owns request TTL. 'gateway' = legacy in-gateway RequestExpirySweeper (today, rollback target). 'delivery-service' = RequestExpiryObserver projects upstream-authored expiry. NEVER both: a gap is safe, an overlap is not. Env override: FeatureFlags__RequestExpiry__Source.

UseUpstream._comment_offer_gw3: GW3 / W3.5(c) 2026-08-01 — this flag no longer selects an offer STORE. The gateway's in-memory offer store was deleted (it moved to the test project as a fixture double), so IPendingOffersStore now always resolves to the thin-BFF UpstreamPendingOffersStore. The flag still gates the ONE remaining legacy offer branch (OffersController's inline accept), which is self-labelled test-only and only works against a store a TEST supplies. (EditInMemoryAsync was named here too until 2026-08-01, when it was deleted as unreachable dead code — its !Offer branch returned 503 rather than calling it.) Left at false because that is the TEST-HARNESS default the integration suite runs on; every deployed overlay sets it true (appsettings.Production.json). Off + no test override = the offer surface is not functional. Deleting the flag outright needs offer-service to grow get-by-id + bulk-withdraw routes (JEBV4-148), an owner / service-owner call.
UseUpstream._comment_payments_REMOVED: REMOVED 2026-07-27 by owner ruling: 'jeeb is only cash on delivery', no unified_payment_gateway. This flag used to swap the cash-settlement ledger post from the in-process ledger to a client that posted THROUGH UPG. It defaulted false, and the UPG client + its typed transport are now DELETED, so nothing reads this key. It is removed rather than left at false because a flag that still LOOKS live but is wired to nothing is exactly the kind of instrument that lies. The in-process COD ledger is now unconditional and permanent. Do NOT re-add. See docs/batches/b02-20260726/UPG-REMOVAL.md.

FeatureFlags._comment_kyc: JEBV4-8 — FeatureFlags:Kyc:AutoApprove: when ON, a first-time KYC submission is adjudicated Verified + the jeeber role granted inline (via the same kyc-service review seam the admin path uses + the UM available_roles append) with NO admin step, and the submit response returns state=Verified so the app renders 'approved' with NO re-login. DEFAULT-OFF here so existing fixtures keep the normal Submitted -> admin-review path; flipped ON only in appsettings.Production.json (MSI dev/staging). Env override: FeatureFlags__Kyc__AutoApprove.

Heartbeat._comment: S06 / ADR-HB-001 — presence cutover to the NEW reusable heart-beat service. Default OFF: the availability surface keeps using the delivery-service presence wire. Flip via FeatureFlags__Heartbeat__Enabled=true once heart-beat is live. roleKey is the OPAQUE consumer namespace heart-beat stores but never interprets.
Heartbeat._comment_serviceAuthKey: S06 AUTH CONTRACT — static X-Service-Auth-Key presented to heart-beat. SECRET — committed BLANK; inject via FeatureFlags__Heartbeat__ServiceAuthKey (== heart-beat's HEARTBEAT_SERVICE_AUTH_KEY). Do NOT enable the flag where this is blank.

Features._comment: DevEndpoints gates the additive /dev/* test-harness routes (DevController). MUST stay false in every committed appsettings; the routes return 404 when off. Flip on ONLY via env var Features__DevEndpoints__Enabled=true in the seeding-harness environment. The gateway never auto-seeds.
Features._comment_swagger: Swagger gates the admin-role-gated /swagger* OpenAPI surface (Program.cs). MUST stay false in every committed appsettings; /swagger* returns 404 when off. Flip on ONLY via env var Features__Swagger__Enabled=true (deploy-to-jeeb.yml swagger_ui input). When ON it is admin-role-gated (non-admin => 404) — NEVER the open Dev/Testing branch. jeeb.fds-1.com is PUBLIC.

Auth._comment: Auth:Otp configures the production phone sign-in OTP orchestration (AuthOtpController, /v1/auth/otp/*). ApplicationId is the Jeeb tenant's application id in the shared one-time-password service, forwarded on every SendOTP/ValidateOTP (the service keys Phone rows by application id). Set per env; the committed default is an empty placeholder. ttlSeconds is the contract constant the gateway surfaces on request (the service does not return a TTL).

AdminOidc._comment: External administrator identity (extracted from PR #364). Committed-false: the live mobile BFF boots with zero new config. Enabling requires the full AdminOidc__* env set (issuer/endpoints/client/StateProtectionKey) plus AdminEvidence__TokenKey; both are enforced fail-closed at startup once Enabled=true.

Realtime._comment_GuardianSecret: realtime-comunication-service verifies every ingest AND every socket connect with ITS OWN Guardian secret, which is NOT the gateway's Jwt:SigningKey. Supply it as the environment variable Services__Realtime__GuardianSecret. NEVER commit a value here. Empty (this default) means the gateway mints no realtime credential: the server-side position fan-out sends none, and GET /v1/realtime/jeeb:delivery/{id} returns 503 rather than degrade onto the upstream's OPEN, UNAUTHENTICATED POST /api/auth/token, which mints topics:["*"] for any caller. The value must MATCH the upstream's Guardian secret exactly and be at least 32 bytes; HS512 wants 64+, and the gateway logs a warning below that, but it is accepted because a shorter secret that the upstream actually verifies with must still be usable — refusing it would only relocate the outage.
Realtime._comment_PublicSocketUrl: The WebSocket url a DEVICE can reach, e.g. ws://192.168.2.39:5804/socket/websocket. Deliberately separate from BaseUrl: BaseUrl is routinely a loopback the gateway dials, and handing a phone ws://127.0.0.1/... fails silently and looks like a product bug. Unset yields a null socketUrl in the descriptor instead of a derived guess.

Kyc._comment: kyc-service (S03/ADR-0004) is NOT yet deployed — repo+DB owner/SSH ESCALATED. PLACEHOLDER BaseUrl; FeatureFlags:UseUpstream:Kyc stays false until the service ships (suggested host port 10074).

HeartBeat._comment: heart-beat (S06 / ADR-HB-001) — NEW reusable presence service (Go + Redis). NOT YET DEPLOYED: PLACEHOLDER BaseUrl (port UNVERIFIED — confirm against the live fleet port map before creating the swarm service). FeatureFlags:Heartbeat:Enabled stays false until the service ships and is smoke-passed.

RoleService._comment: role-service (olivium-dev/role-service, LIVE-DARK on MSI :10091). BaseUrl + ApiKey committed BLANK; injected via Services__RoleService__{BaseUrl,ApiKey} at deploy. FeatureFlags:UseUpstream:RoleService stays absent/false everywhere until cutover.

WalletGuard._comment: F1 OQ1 UNRESOLVED, blocks merge: fail-open|fail-closed when wallet-service is unreachable at the offer submit/accept/edit guard. fail-closed is the default pending owner ratification.

CancellationPolicy._comment: JEB-1507: configurable thresholds for the Jeeber progressive-ban cancellation policy. WeeklyThreshold: max cancellations within WeeklyWindowDays before restriction is applied. StrikeThreshold: reserved for future progressive-ban escalation. RestrictionDurationHours: how long the Jeeber is restricted after tripping WeeklyThreshold.

Push._comment_Fcm_REMOVED: REMOVED 2026-07-31 (b05/GW1 W0.6) by owner ruling: the gateway must NEVER speak to a push provider itself — every push leaves via the push microservice (:10040). This block held 'FcmProjectId', 'FcmBearerToken' and 'UseFcmTransport'. The transport class they configured is DELETED, not flag-disabled, so nothing reads these keys. They are removed rather than left at their placeholders because two credential-shaped keys with no consumer are a landmine: someone fills them in and believes push now leaves the gateway. Do NOT re-add. InMemoryPushTransport(Fcm)+(Apns) is now the unconditional registration (Program.cs).

GeoHistoryWrite._comment: Stateless bounded retry for durable 30-day GPS evidence. A geolocation 429 is expected flow control: honor Retry-After and never let the throttle open the client-wide circuit.

RealtimePublish._comment: Continuous courier position. When Enabled, an accepted POST /location/update fix that names a delivery is also TryEnqueue'd onto a bounded channel and published to realtime-comunication-service (topic jeeb:delivery:{id}, stream location) by CourierPositionPublisher. Fire-and-forget by construction: the location write is the money path and never awaits, retries, or observes this. Off by default; also requires FeatureFlags:UseUpstream:Realtime and a Services:Realtime:GuardianSecret.
